Speed and angle filters for track models

Source: R/track_filter.R
track_speedfilter.Rd

track_speedfilter() flags fixes that imply a speed of travel above max_speed, with the iterative running root mean square of McConnell et al. (1992). track_sda() adds the distance and angle tests of Freitas et al. (2008). Both are ports of speedfilter() and sda() from the 'trip' package; the fixes are not removed, the result says which pass.

track_speedfilter(x, max_speed, ...)

track_sda(x, smax, ang = c(15, 25), distlim = c(2.5, 5), pre = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

a track model, or anything as_track() accepts

max_speed, smax

maximum speed (km/h for longitude and latitude)

...

unused

ang

minimum turning angles in degrees, one per pass

distlim

maximum step lengths in km, one per pass

pre

optional logical vector, one per fix, of fixes already rejected (FALSE) by another filter

Value

A data frame with .fix and the logical ok, FALSE where the fix fails.

Details

Speeds are in km/h and distances in km for longitude and latitude (geodesic distance), as in 'trip'; otherwise in coordinate units per hour and coordinate units. track_sda() needs longitude and latitude.

Two differences from 'trip' 1.10.0. The speed over two segments (from a fix to the one after next) uses the distance between those two fixes; 'trip' measured it along the wrong pairs of fixes for longitude and latitude data, so its flags can differ there. And where 'trip' could loop forever on a track whose remaining fixes are too few for the running mean, the filter stops for that track.

References

McConnell, B. J., Chambers, C. and Fedak, M. A. (1992) Foraging ecology of southern elephant seals in relation to the bathymetry and productivity of the Southern Ocean. Antarctic Science 4:393-398.

Freitas, C., Lydersen, C., Fedak, M. A. and Kovacs, K. M. (2008) A simple new algorithm to filter marine mammal Argos locations. Marine Mammal Science 24:315-325. doi:10.1111/j.1748-7692.2007.00180.x

Examples

tr <- as_track(trips0)
table(track_speedfilter(tr, max_speed = 20)$ok)
#> 
#> FALSE  TRUE 
#>   611   889 
table(track_sda(tr, smax = 20)$ok)
#> 
#> FALSE  TRUE 
#>   720   780
